messages:
maria: Quick question — product wants a per-route chargeback view that shows model-SKU granularity plus cache-credit offsets. Current cost dashboard groups by model_family and hides when routing falls back to smaller quantized SKUs.

cheng: Do we actually emit SKU at request time? I thought runtime only tags backend_model_id and we map to family later in the pipeline.

maria: Runtime emits backend_model_id and model_sku (e.g., gptx-8q, gptx-8-fp16). We currently collapse to family in the OLAP ETL for storage reasons. The ask is to retain both dims for billing queries.

olivia: UX: product wants a tenant-level default with a per-route toggle. Also top-5 SKU breakdown and an option to see "credits applied" column. Mockups incoming. :eyes:  https://docs.google.com/fake-link-sku-chargeback

samir: Heads-up from infra: SKU-level dims increase cardinality. We should avoid blowing up dashboard queries. Proposal: daily pre-aggregated ledger table with (date, tenant_id, route_id, model_sku, tokens_gross, tokens_cache_saved, cost_usd_est, request_count). That keeps queries fast.

maria: Agree. Also need to ensure cache_credit accounting is clear: when we serve from KV, runtime sets cache_hit=true and cache_credit_tokens=int. Right now ETL applies credits as negative tokens on the same row; thinking we surface gross_tokens and cache_savings side-by-side.

cheng: If we do ledger, we also need the exact mapping we use for routing attribution. Example: if request tried sku A then fell back to sku B, we should record final_sku and attempted_skus array for diagnostics, but we probably only surface final_sku to billing.

olivia: UX note — attempted_skus could be available behind an "advanced" toggle (diagnostics) so main dashboards don't get noisy.

samir: For implementation: we can add a new job that emits daily SKU_LEDGER partitioned by date and tenant_id. ETL pseudocode: 

```sql
INSERT INTO sku_ledger (date, tenant_id, route_id, model_sku, tokens_gross, tokens_cache_saved, cost_usd_est, requests)
SELECT date(ts), tenant_id, route_id, model_sku, SUM(tokens) AS tokens_gross, SUM(cache_credit) AS tokens_cache_saved, SUM(estimate_cost(tokens, model_sku)) AS cost_usd_est, COUNT(*)
FROM raw_inference_events
WHERE ts >= @start AND ts < @end
GROUP BY date(ts), tenant_id, route_id, model_sku;
```

samir: We'll keep per-minute rollups for SLOs but daily ledger for billing/analytics.

maria: Nice. Product also wants a CSV export and per-route API for finance to pull data programmatically.

olivia: I'll attach mockups to the doc and add two UI states: (1) Tenant overview with top SKUs + credits summary, (2) Route detail with CSV export and ledger query link.

cheng: Backend tasks: add `model_sku` to the raw event schema (if missing), ensure runtime emits `cache_credit_tokens`, and add transform to produce sku_ledger. I'll take the ETL PR.

billing-bot: billing-bot: New event type `sku_charge` ingested for invoice draft 2026-02-28.

maria: Action items: olivia mockups (ETA EOD Wed), cheng ETL PR (ETA Fri), samir infra capacity check and cost estimate for extra partitions (ETA Thu). I'll coordinate finance API requirements. :+1:

olivia: ack.

samir: ack.

cheng: ack — will post PR link when ready.

maria: Great — we can review in next eng-platform sync if required. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
